error_model.logging: Logs errors via configured logger; raises on validation and binding failures.
raises: RuntimeError for duplicate conduits or configuration mismatches
ValueError for invalid configuration or policy
TypeError for invalid hook or argument types

side_effects: Conjures a single Conduit and binds configuration
Maintains contracted spell maps for linked conduits

runtime_couplings: Uses Aether for shared frame configuration and spell system states

dependents.notes: Central registry used by Conduit and DevOps subsystems.

integration_flow: Conjure a conduit after configuration is frozen

usage_snippets.code:
spellbook = Spellbook()
spellbook.bind(spell=MyService, existence=Existence.unique)
conduit = spellbook.conjure()

lifecycle.construction: Initializes configuration, spell registries, and binding/validation helpers.

invariants: Only one Conduit can be conjured per Spellbook
Configuration is validated and frozen before conjure
non_goals: Does not permit multiple conduits per Spellbook
pitfalls: Binding duplicate spell_id within the same frame
Conjuring with dynamic policy in automatic system_state
responsibilities: Manage configuration and Aether frame integration

conjure freezes configuration and runs phases
contracted spell management for linked conduits
